description: This Kotlin file defines the HomeFragment class, a UI component displaying a grid of recipes. It sets up a RecyclerView with a GridLayoutManager, initializes a RecipeAdapter, navigates to detail view on recipe selection, and observes a ViewModel for recipe data.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment displaying a grid of recipes, setting up RecyclerView with adapter and handling navigation to recipe details.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView, sets layout manager, adapter, observes recipes data, and triggers data load.
